name: HARPA AI
notes: Recorded as adjacent: the publisher's getting-started guide presents HARPA mainly as a page-aware AI chat for summarizing, writing and search, with an AUTOMATE tab for page monitors and scheduled commands. The reviewed guides describe page actions as user-built command steps (NAVIGATE, CLICK, PASTE, SCROLL, EXTRACT, RUN JS) that run in the open tab and can be combined with GPT steps, rather than a model that plans clicks from screenshots. The homepage is not used as a receipt because its email-obfuscation markup changes on every request.
summary: Chrome extension that brings chat models to any web page for summaries and writing, with an automation engine whose user-built commands navigate, click, paste, extract and monitor pages around AI steps.
